statement: SELECT concat(cast(date(ts) as string),' n=',cast(count(*) as string),' avg=',cast(round(avg(prediction),3) as string),' med=',cast(round(percentile(prediction,0.5),3) as string),' sd=',cast(round(stddev(prediction),3) as string)) AS row FROM workspace.mlpab768409.prediction_log WHERE date(ts) BETWEEN '2026-03-01' AND '2026-03-14' GROUP BY date(ts) ORDER BY date(ts)
